deliverables.Title: AV / Network Design Coordination
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Preliminary speaker, wireless AP, and related device layouts are being coordinated against developing ceiling information. Current design work is progressing while final coordinated RCP information and several client/design decisions remain outstanding.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Final coordinated RCPs, Gallery resolution, and remaining client/design decisions affecting ceiling-device coordination.
deliverables.NextStep: Continue coordinated AV/network device-layout development and incorporate the next coordinated RCP release.
deliverables.Risk: Final speaker, AP, and related device locations remain dependent on evolving ceiling/RCP coordination and design decisions.

deliverables.Title: Technical Power Coordination
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Developing technical power requirements and equipment-room electrical coordination.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Final coordinated equipment and control requirements as design develops.
deliverables.NextStep: Continue technical power plans and coordinate panel/riser requirements with the MEP team.
deliverables.Risk: Late design changes can affect panel schedules, room layouts, and power distribution.

deliverables.Title: Lighting Control / Shade Coordination
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Lighting-control coordination is being revised around the agreed PIR-first approach. PIR will be primary in appropriate spaces, unnecessary hallway/transient keypads will be removed, and selected manual overrides will remain in destination spaces and locations requiring shade control.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Completion of the revised AHT PIR/keypad layout followed by Claire / Russell review and continuing coordinated lighting/ceiling information.
deliverables.NextStep: Complete revised PIR/keypad locations, verify sensor coverage and retained shade/manual-control locations, then review the plan room-by-room with Claire / Russell.
deliverables.Risk: Lighting, ceiling, shade, and occupancy-control changes can affect final keypad/PIR quantities and locations.

deliverables.Title: AV Room Heat Load / BTU Coordination
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Waiting on final equipment confirmations. Maintaining equipment-room heat-load assumptions from planned AV, network, and control equipment.
deliverables.NextStep: Update room heat-load calculations as equipment selections and rack layouts are refined.
deliverables.Risk: Equipment changes can affect final cooling requirements.

deliverables.Title: Keypad Locations
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Revising keypad and PIR locations using the agreed control logic. PIR will be primary in appropriate spaces, hallway/transient keypads will generally be removed, and selected manual overrides will remain where functionality, reliability, or shade control warrants them.
deliverables.WaitingOn: AHT drawing revision followed by Claire / Russell review.
deliverables.NextStep: Verify PIR coverage, complete the revised keypad/PIR layout, and review locations room-by-room with Claire / Russell before finalizing.
deliverables.Risk: Final quantities and locations remain subject to room-by-room review, PIR coverage requirements, code considerations, shade control needs, and desired manual override locations.

deliverables.Title: Main House Speaker Layout
deliverables.CurrentActivity: A preliminary coverage-based main-house speaker layout has been developed using 3-inch small-aperture speakers and generally coordinated to the current lighting geometry.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Russell / design-team feedback on visible speaker quantity and ceiling aesthetics, plus coordinated RCP information.
deliverables.NextStep: Review the preliminary layout with Russell and determine whether to retain the current 3-inch small-aperture approach or develop a lower-quantity alternate speaker solution.
deliverables.Risk: The current small-aperture approach achieves coverage but may result in an aesthetically undesirable speaker quantity; final placement is also dependent on coordinated ceiling information.

deliverables.Title: Revised Wi-Fi Heat Map
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Preliminary AP locations are based on current heat-map coverage. Locations are being adjusted to conceal APs where practical and coordinate them with ceiling conditions and available service access.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Final speaker / ceiling-access strategy and coordinated RCP information.
deliverables.NextStep: Refine AP locations after the ceiling/speaker access strategy is confirmed and issue the revised Wi-Fi heat map.
deliverables.Risk: Final AP placement can shift with speaker selection, ceiling access, soffit conditions, and other ceiling-device coordination.

deliverables.Title: Door-by-Door Access Plan
deliverables.NextStep: Develop door-by-door requirements and preliminary access plan.

deliverables.Title: Resource Planning
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Tracking staffing and resource needs for upcoming 2200 engineering and construction coordination.
deliverables.NextStep: Confirm current staffing/resource plan and update the project-control record as project needs develop.
deliverables.Risk: Resource needs will increase as permitting, approvals, and construction activity expand.

deliverables.Title: Working Shade Mockup
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Coordinating a working shade mockup and associated fabric/sample sequence.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Fabric/sample availability and coordinated mockup requirements.
deliverables.NextStep: Complete the working mockup once the required fabric/sample material is available.
deliverables.Risk: Mockup timing depends on material availability and coordinated design requirements.

deliverables.Title: Temporary CCTV & Wi-Fi Plan
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Developing temporary CCTV and Wi-Fi coverage planning for the construction phase.
deliverables.NextStep: Issue the temporary CCTV and Wi-Fi plan for coordination.
deliverables.Risk: Construction conditions and temporary infrastructure may require revisions.

deliverables.Title: Shade Controls
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Shade control design will follow the coordinated lighting-control and keypad direction.
deliverables.NextStep: Begin detailed shade-control design once coordinated lighting/keypad information is sufficiently developed.
deliverables.Risk: Lighting/keypad changes can affect shade-control coordination.

deliverables.Title: Auxiliary Building AV / Security Layouts
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Preliminary auxiliary-building layouts have not started because the required architectural drawings are still outstanding.
deliverables.NextStep: Begin preliminary AV, network, CCTV, and access layouts when the auxiliary-building backgrounds are received.
deliverables.Risk: Late backgrounds can compress coordination time for auxiliary-building systems.

deliverables.Title: Landscape / Exterior Systems Layouts
deliverables.CurrentActivity: Exterior AV, Wi-Fi, CCTV, and access planning is waiting on coordinated landscape drawings.
deliverables.NextStep: Develop preliminary exterior-system layouts when the landscape backgrounds are received.
deliverables.Risk: Landscape and exterior-design changes can affect device locations, pathways, and coverage.

deliverables.Title: Device Location Review Package
deliverables.CurrentActivity: The preliminary coordinated device-location package is being developed from the current speaker, Wi-Fi/AP, PIR/keypad, CCTV, access, lighting, shade, and related discipline layouts.
deliverables.WaitingOn: Current discipline layouts reaching a reviewable state, coordinated RCP information, and remaining design/client decisions affecting device locations.
deliverables.NextStep: Incorporate the current discipline revisions and assemble the coordinated preliminary device-location package for design-team review.
deliverables.Risk: The package depends on multiple discipline layouts and ceiling/design decisions progressing together; late changes can require coordinated revisions across several systems.
